$comment: Degraded-mode specification. Owned by the Head of Fraud, quarterly.
'Degraded-mode behaviour is a requirement, not a fallback.' Every mode
names, IN ADVANCE, which rules it suspends and which it activates, and the
sets are recorded on every event assessed while the mode was in force.
Four model-presence states rather than two, because spec s11.7 splits the
model in two and the four combinations must be enumerated rather than
derived. Deriving them is how a serving incident on the scam model quietly

rows.note: One non-critical source degraded. Rules follow their own per-feature on_absent behaviour and nothing global changes. This mode exists to be RECORDED, not to act.

suspends: $and 34 more — the full list is the artefact
rows.note: 38 suspended, 15 activated. The activated set references no model score and no velocity aggregate by construction, checked at validation — a compensating rule that reads the thing that just broke is not a compensating rule.

forced.rule: payments to never-before-paid beneficiaries above threshold are held rather than allowed
